name: io.github.giorgio44/gateonai-mcp
title: GateOnAI
description: Search and compare AI tools, use cases, AI stacks, workflows, EU/GDPR provider statements. No key.

tools.name: search_ai_tools
tools.description: Search GateOnAI's database of 3,783 listed AI tools. Find tools by name, use case, category, pricing model, or GDPR info on the provider's page. Returns tool names, descriptions, pricing, GateOnAI scores, and direct URLs.

query.description: Search term — tool name, use case, or description. Examples: 'video editing', 'code assistant', 'ChatGPT alternatives'

pricing.description: Filter by pricing model: free, freemium, paid, or free_trial

gdpr_only.description: Set to true to return only tools whose provider pages refer to the GDPR

eu_hosted_only.description: Set to true to return only tools whose providers state EU hosting

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 24)

tools.name: get_ai_workflow
tools.description: Generate a step-by-step AI workflow for any profession, role, or business task. Uses GateOnAI's compatibility graph of 84,081 computed tool connections to suggest a tool sequence.

query.description: Describe your role, profession, or goal. Examples: 'freelance graphic designer building a client workflow', 'startup founder automating customer support', 'marketing manager creating YouTube content'

tools.name: compare_ai_tools
tools.description: Compare two or three AI tools side by side from GateOnAI data: pricing model, category, GateOnAI Score, pros and cons. GateOnAI does not pick a winner. The GateOnAI Score follows GateOnAI's own automatic method, not a universal ranking.

tool1_slug.description: URL slug of the first tool to compare. Examples: 'chatgpt', 'claude', 'midjourney', 'jasper'

tool2_slug.description: URL slug of the second tool to compare. Examples: 'google-gemini', 'dall-e-3', 'elevenlabs', 'notion'

tool3_slug.description: Optional third tool slug for a 3-way comparison (e.g. 'perplexity')

tools.name: get_tool_details
tools.description: Get comprehensive details about a specific AI tool by its URL slug. Returns the description, pricing model, GateOnAI Score breakdown, pros and cons, GDPR / EU-hosting statements from the provider's own page, and FAQ.

slug.description: URL slug of the AI tool. Examples: 'chatgpt', 'midjourney', 'notion', 'github-copilot', 'claude'

include.description: Optional extra sections: use_cases (use-case pages listing it), guides (GateOnAI guides that mention it), prompts (prompt counts by profession), dna (input/output tags and connections)

tools.name: get_trending_tools
tools.description: Get AI tools that are trending on GateOnAI by a fixed rule: at least 3 clicks to the tool's own website from GateOnAI visitors in the last 7 days (bots not counted). The list can be empty; the answer then says so and suggests whats_new (recently added tools) or search_ai_tools.

limit.description: Number of trending tools to return (default: 10, max: 20)

tools.name: get_eu_gdpr_tools
tools.description: Find AI tools whose providers, on their own websites, refer to the GDPR or state EU data hosting. Each result quotes the provider's own sentence, links the source page and gives the date of GateOnAI's automatic check (about monthly). These are provider statements, not an audit, verification or certification by GateOnAI - check the provider's current documents before relying on them.

standard.description: Compliance standard: 'gdpr' for tools whose provider pages refer to the GDPR, 'eu_hosted' for tools whose providers state EU hosting

query.description: Optional: words to match in the tool name or tagline, e.g. 'transcription' or 'chatbot'

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 24)

tools.name: get_prompts_for_profession
tools.description: Get ready-to-use AI prompts for a specific profession from GateOnAI's library of 10,189 prompts across 76 professions. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs.

limit.description: Number of prompts to return (default: 5, max: 20)

tools.name: get_site_stats
tools.description: Get current live statistics about the GateOnAI platform including total listed tools, categories, tool compatibility connections, and prompt library size.

include_site_map.description: Also list the site's sections with page counts and example links

tools.name: get_compatible_tools
tools.description: Find AI tools that may connect with a given tool, based on GateOnAI's IO-Compatibility Graph - computed automatically by matching the input/output content types (text, image, audio, video, code, etc.) that GateOnAI assigns to each tool. The tags are assigned automatically and can be wrong; connections are not tested. Answers questions like 'what tools work well with ChatGPT' or 'what can I feed ChatGPT's output into'. The graph has 84,081 computed connections. Without a slug: an overview of the whole graph and its most connected tools.

slug.description: URL slug of the AI tool to find connections for. Examples: 'chatgpt', 'midjourney', 'claude'

limit.description: Number of connected tools to return (default: 8, max: 20)

tools.name: find_ai_pipeline
tools.description: Find a computed sequence of AI tools that gets you from one type of content to another - e.g. audio to a finished blog post, or a single image to a full video. Powered by GateOnAI's IO-Compatibility Graph combined with a PostgreSQL recursive path-finding engine (not an LLM improvising) - each step is a listed tool whose tagged output type matches the next tool's tagged input type. The tags are assigned automatically and the pipelines are not tested. Returns multiple ranked alternative pipelines, each scored on tool quality and path length, so you can compare a fast 2-step option against a more thorough 4-step one. Valid content types: text, image, audio, video, data, url, code, pdf, email, social_post, prompt, file.

start_type.description: The type of content you are starting with

goal_type.description: The type of content you want to end up with

max_steps.description: Maximum number of tools in the chain (2-6, default 4)

alternatives.description: Number of alternative pipelines to return (1-5, default 3)

free_only.description: If true, only return pipelines where every single tool in the chain is free or freemium

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: See real AI tools recently added to GateOnAI - based on genuine addition timestamps, not a guess or a static list. Optionally filter by category. Useful for staying current on new tool launches or checking what's new in a specific space (e.g. new AI Agents tools this week).

days.description: How many days back to look (1-30, default 7)

category.description: Optional category slug to filter by, e.g. 'ai-agents', 'marketing', 'design'. Omit to see all categories.

tools.name: find_similar_by_philosophy
tools.description: Find AI tools that are conceptually or philosophically similar to a given tool - based on real semantic embedding similarity of each tool's name and tagline (MiniLM), not just shared category. Different from get_compatible_tools, which uses the structural IO-Compatibility Graph (real input/output matching) rather than meaning-based similarity. Use this for 'tools like X' questions, get_compatible_tools for 'what connects to X' questions.

slug.description: URL slug of the AI tool to find similar tools for. Examples: 'chatgpt', 'midjourney', 'notion'

limit.description: Number of similar tools to return (default: 8, max: 20)

tools.name: get_market_landscape
tools.description: A real, computed statistical snapshot of one GateOnAI category: live tool count, real GateOnAI Score distribution (average/median/min/max) and current top-scoring tools. Every number is computed directly from live catalog data at request time - never a prediction, estimate, or industry-wide claim beyond what GateOnAI itself catalogs.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. 'ai-agents', 'design', 'marketing', 'writing-assistant'. Use search_ai_tools or browse to find valid category slugs if unsure.

tools.name: match_prompt_to_task
tools.description: Given a free-text description of a task (e.g. 'write a cold email to a client'), finds the best-matching existing prompt(s) from GateOnAI's prompt library using real BM25 full-text search - not a semantic guess or an invented relevance score. Each result includes the actual prompt text, which tool it's designed for, and the profession it comes from.

task.description: Free-text description of the task, e.g. 'write a cold email to a client' or 'summarize a legal contract'

limit.description: Number of matching prompts to return (1-10, default 5)

tools.name: get_workflow_template
tools.description: Get one of GateOnAI's 90 pre-built, ready-made AI workflows for a specific profession - a deterministic, ordered sequence of steps each matched to a real tool by category and GateOnAI Score, regenerated live from current tool data. Different from get_ai_workflow: this returns an existing, pre-built template for a known profession rather than generating a new custom one from free text - faster and more consistent for common roles.

profession.description: Profession slug. Examples: 'blogger', 'general-contractor', 'marketing-manager', 'software-developer', '3d-artist'. If unsure of the exact slug, use get_ai_workflow instead with a free-text description.

tools.name: build_workflow_board
tools.description: Turn a goal described in plain language into a GateOnAI Workbench board: real tools from the GateOnAI catalog, connected step by step when they form a workflow. Returns the steps and a share link that contains the board itself - nothing is stored on GateOnAI's servers. The user can open the link, clone the board into their own Workbench and share it. Use when the user wants a ready-made, visual AI workflow they can open and edit.

goal.description: What the user wants to achieve, e.g. 'turn podcast episodes into blog posts and short social clips'

tools.name: analyze_ai_stack
tools.description: Automated observations about a set of AI tools (2-40 GateOnAI tool slugs): tools not currently listed, category overlaps, data connections in GateOnAI's IO-compatibility graph, and (My AI Stack DNA) what the stack can make together by input/output type, output types none of the tools gives with the highest-scored tools that could fill them, tools with identical inputs and outputs, and facts (EU hosting stated by the provider, listed MCP server). A connection means one tool gives out a type the other takes in (GateOnAI tags), not a confirmed integration. Observations from GateOnAI data only - not recommendations and not judgments about any provider.

tool_slugs.description: GateOnAI tool slugs, e.g. ['chatgpt', 'elevenlabs', 'opus-clip'] (slugs appear in search results and tool URLs)

tools.name: browse_categories
tools.description: All GateOnAI categories with their tool counts, or the tools of one category ordered by GateOnAI Score (free_only=true: the category's free-plan list). Same data as the site's category pages. Pricing model only, never prices.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. 'ai-agents'. Leave out for the list of categories.

free_only.description: Only tools with a free plan (the site's free-tools list)

limit.description: How many tools / items to return (default 10)

tools.name: find_tools_for_task
tools.description: GateOnAI's use-case pages (/ai-tool-for/...): the tools listed for one task such as 'blog writing' or '3d image generation'. Give words or a slug; without a task you get the popular use cases. Pages that do not meet GateOnAI's publishing rule are marked as drafts.

task.description: Task words or use-case slug, e.g. 'transcribe meetings' or 'blog-writing'

limit.description: How many tools / items to return (default 10)

tools.name: get_alternatives
tools.description: Listed AI tools with a similar purpose to one tool (the site's /alternatives/ page): pricing model, category, GateOnAI Score. GateOnAI does not pick a winner.

limit.description: How many tools / items to return (default 10)

tools.name: get_ai_stack_page
tools.description: GateOnAI's AI stack pages (/ai-stack-for/...): a step-by-step plan of listed tools for one audience, such as content creators or designers. Without audience you get the list of pages.

audience.description: Page slug, e.g. 'content-creators'. Leave out for the list.

tools.name: get_stack_for_role
tools.description: My AI Stack: the listed tools and steps that GateOnAI's My AI Stack page shows for one job role (thousands of roles across sectors). Give a job title; if several roles match, you get their slugs to choose from.

role.description: Job title or role slug, e.g. 'podcast producer', 'nurse', 'data-analyst'

limit.description: How many tools / items to return (default 10)

tools.name: get_best_for
tools.description: Top listed tools by GateOnAI Score for one goal (e.g. writing, images, coding) or for one category. Without arguments you get the goals. Scores are GateOnAI's own method, not an industry standard.

category.description: Category slug instead of a goal, e.g. 'ai-agents'

limit.description: How many tools / items to return (default 10)

tools.name: read_guides
tools.description: GateOnAI's guides and weekly notes (the blog): list or search them, or read one by slug - sections, the start of the text, the tools it names and the link to the full text.

query.description: Words to search titles, summaries and tags

slug.description: Guide slug to read one guide

limit.description: How many tools / items to return (default 10)

tools.name: get_community_workflows
tools.description: Workflow boards shared on GateOnAI (by GateOnAI or by visitors who chose to share them): title, steps, tools and how often they were copied. No personal data.

query.description: Words to filter by title, description or profession

limit.description: How many tools / items to return (default 10)
